issues.reason: Sealing projects only a definite referent's Member/Name TYPING atom; a part-whole predication is not typing, and its second argument sk_house_1 is an indefinite posited only inside the seal, so the top-level atom both over-asserts and leaves an untyped referent symbol in the output, which Names & casing forbids.

Compound concepts fuses an adjective+noun only for a recognized kind (term of art, nationality, role title, material) and 'never for incidental description', and on a plural a descriptive modifier distributes over the members rather than riding in the group's kind slot — 'missing' is a condition of these three teenagers, like 'dented pail'.

Uncovering/discovering neither creates, destroys, consumes nor physically changes the bodies — it is the evaluate/record class the instruction set routes to Theme, and Theme is also the stated default when the change test is unclear.

'A participle used as a modifier is an adjective, not the verb' ('a laminated worktop' -> (Member sk_worktop_1 laminated)); reifying a pour event with (Past sk_pour_1) asserts an occurrence the pre-nominal modifier only presupposes, in contrast with the post-nominal 'buried', which is correctly a reduced relative.

gaps_confirmed: an adverb modifying a pre-nominal participle ('freshly poured') — with the participle adjectival there is no slot for the adverb (Degree takes intensifiers/downtoners, not manner), and reifying an event to host it asserts an occurrence

a bare plural subject on a specific episodic reading ('authorities said Wednesday') — the determiner rule routes bare plurals to generics/rules and states the group-witness route for definite/counted plurals
new_gaps: a per-member distribution rule has no expressible form inside a seal: the sealed (And …) carries no TV slot for the rule's 1.0/0.9 and the rule's free $x enters a stored term — the same species as the registered 'no polarity carrier inside a seal' limitation

a definite whose head noun takes an indefinite of-complement inside a seal ('the basement of a house'): the definite's typing projects but its PartOf link and its whole must stay sealed, so the projected symbol is left unattached at top level
'beneath' as an event oblique — Location is glossed as in/at/on and the surface-preposition rule is stated for entity-attached position, leaving the event-side head for 'buried beneath X' unsettled
repair_summary: Moved (PartOf sk_basement_1 sk_house_1) from top level into the sealed complement beside (Member sk_house_1 house). Split missing_teenager: (GroupOf sk_teens_1 teenager) plus the distribution rule (Implication (PartOf $x sk_teens_1) (Member $x missing)), dropping both decomposition atoms. Changed (Patient sk_uncover_1 sk_bodies_1) to Theme. Replaced the reified pour event (class, Patient, Manner freshly, Past) with the adjectival (Member sk_concrete_1 poured), dropping 'freshly' as unrepresentable.
notes: 'freshly' is dropped rather than mis-slotted into Degree or Manner, per the no-invention rule, and is recorded as a gap. The parse's (Location sk_bury_1 sk_concrete_1) for 'beneath the concrete' was left untouched as no confirmed issue names it, though the surface preposition is lost there.
